messages:
asha: Heads-up: setting up a 30m pre-QBR triage for Verdant (QBR Tue 10AM PT). Focus: token econ for embeddings-heavy workloads, 90-day spend forecast, and enablement blockers. Can we do a 3pm PT sync today? cc @dylan @priya

dylan: I9m available at 3pm PT. Do we have the latest per-route usage export? Last export showed ~1.2M vectors/mo but they flipped to 512-d recently.

priya: I9ll pull onboarding notes + enablement action items. There9s an outstanding task around batch inference and cache hooks that will materially affect token counts. Sharing doc shortly.

priya: https://redwood.internal/verdant/batch-infer - note: switched to 512-d embeddings last week, so cost vectors changed.

sanjay_fin: Billing flag came in (invoice B-7890). Quick snapshot: run rate ~$8.7k/mo today; embeddings ~68% of spend. If usage doubles post-launch, forecast ~ $17-18k/mo. Suggest we prepare commit vs throttle options.

milo_support: Enablement note: their integration is missing caching callbacks, so we9re seeing repeated prefix embeddings. I can demo a minimal cache snippet in the pre-QBR and follow up with code.

asha: Proposed agenda for the 30m: 1) run-rate + two growth scenarios (x1.2, x2) 2) immediate cost levers (batching, KV cache, quantization) 3) enablement asks & owners. Good?

dylan: Fine. I9ll bring a per-route token breakdown and a small script to produce a 90-day spend forecast: `python scripts/forecast.py --account verdant --days 90`

priya: I9ll lead the enablement demo and create a follow-up checklist. Action: we should send a pre-QBR cost snapshot to Verdant PM with suggested throttles.

sanjay_fin: I9ll draft options: 1) reserved/burst capacity for nightly batch jobs 2) account-level quota guardrails 3) commit math (discounts vs on-demand). ETA EOD with numbers.

ops-bot: Billing alert: Verdant usage spike +82% vs baseline yesterday 94 triggered rule embed_spike_high. Details: https://redwood.ops/alerts/67890

asha: Locking 3pm PT. Milo paste the cache snippet here and Dylan/Sanjay post the quick forecast table before the meeting. I9ll invite the Verdant PM and attach pre-read. :thumbsup:

milo_support: caching snippet (pseudo):
```
# prefix KV cache to avoid re-embedding
if prefix in kv_cache:
  return kv_cache[prefix]
else:
  v = embeddings_api.embed(prefix)
  kv_cache[prefix] = v
  return v
```
Full playbook attached after the meeting.

dylan: Rough forecast (quick):
- current run rate: $8.7k/mo
- growth x1.2 -> $10.4k/mo
- growth x2 -> $17.4k/mo
Assumes avg request = 2 vectors @512-d. Will push CSV breakdown to the thread.

sanjay_fin: Creating reserve vs throttle options doc at /shared/finance/verdant-cost-options and tagging CSMs. ETA EOD.

asha: Thanks all. If someone can9t make the sync, drop notes here and tag owners. End.
